"""One instrumented FPM hour; retain original lifecycle assertions and all evidence."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import subprocess
import sys

out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
launch = json.loads((out / 'launch.json').read_text())
source = Path(launch['sourceDirectory'])
if (out / 'state.json').exists():
    raise RuntimeError('Preserve existing run state')

def utc():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

def sha(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while data := stream.read(1048576):
            digest.update(data)
    return digest.hexdigest()

def fingerprint():
    commit = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=source, text=True).strip()
    status = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=source, text=True)
    if commit != launch['sourceCommit'] or status:
        raise RuntimeError('Frozen runtime source identity/cleanliness changed')
    paths = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z'], cwd=source, text=True).split('\0')
    manifest = {name: sha(source/name) for name in paths if name}
    artifacts = [source/'build/asyncara.so', Path(launch['archive']), Path(launch['fpmBinary']),
        Path(launch['phpBinary']), out/'wait-probe.so', out/'fpm_poll_profile.php',
        out/'fpm-wrapper.py', out/'analyze_waits.py', out/'launch.json', Path(__file__)]
    return {'sourceManifest': manifest, 'artifacts': {str(path): sha(path) for path in artifacts}}

identity = fingerprint()
state = dict(launch, status='RUNNING', startedUtc=utc(), supervisorPid=os.getpid(),
    platform=platform.platform(), identities=identity, jobs=[])

def save():
    temporary = out/'state.tmp'
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2)+'\n')
    temporary.replace(out/'state.json')

env = os.environ | {'PHP_BIN': launch['phpBinary'], 'FPM_BIN': str(out/'fpm-wrapper.py')}
env.pop('ASYNCARA_BACKEND', None)
env.pop('ASYNCARA_EXTENSION', None)
if env.get('LD_PRELOAD'):
    raise RuntimeError('Expected clean preload environment')
save()
try:
    command = [sys.executable, str(source/'tests/soak/fpm.py'), '--seconds',
        str(launch['requestedSeconds']), '--output', str(out/'workload')]
    with (out/'driver.log').open('x') as log:
        child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=source, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                 stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        job = {'kind':'fpm', 'status':'RUNNING', 'pid':child.pid, 'startedUtc':utc(), 'command':command}
        state['jobs'].append(job)
        save()
        code = child.wait()
    job.update(exit=code, finishedUtc=utc(), status='FAIL')
    report_path = out/'workload/report.json'
    if report_path.exists():
        report = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
        valid = isinstance(report, list) and report and all(case.get('status') == 'PASS' for case in report)
        valid = valid and any(case.get('name') == 'mixed-reload-kill' and
            case.get('seconds', 0) >= launch['requestedSeconds'] for case in report)
        if code == 0 and valid:
            job['status'] = 'PASS'
        job['reportSha256'] = sha(report_path)
    state['workloadStatus'] = job['status']
    state['identitiesUnchanged'] = fingerprint() == identity
    probe_errors = []
    for path in (out/'workload').rglob('*.log'):
        with path.open('rb') as stream:
            if any(b'Asyncara wait probe failed' in line for line in stream):
                probe_errors.append(str(path.relative_to(out)))
    state['probeErrorLogs'] = probe_errors
    with (out/'analysis.log').open('x') as log:
        analysis = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(out/'analyze_waits.py'), str(out),
            '--output', str(out/'analysis.json')], stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    state['analysisExit'] = analysis.returncode
    state['status'] = 'PASS' if job['status'] == 'PASS' and state['identitiesUnchanged'] and not probe_errors and analysis.returncode == 0 else 'FAIL'
except BaseException as error:
    state.update(status='SUPERVISOR_ERROR', error=repr(error))
    raise
finally:
    state['finishedUtc'] = utc()
    save()
